scripts.dev: npm run build -w @app/shared && concurrently -k "npm run dev -w @app/shared" "npm run dev -w @app/server" "npm run dev -w @app/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @app/shared && npm run build -w @app/server && npm run build -w @app/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @app/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @app/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
